title: What's New: Dataverse & Dynamics 365 App Integration (2023 release wave 2) Part 1

chapters.title: Document filtering and data consolidation strategies
Additional field mappings and event-based synchronization control
Virtual tables and commercial licensing changes
Multi-company synchronization toggle and virtual table setup
Integration configuration and default connection setup

features.name: Multi-company and multi-environment synchronization
features.description: Enables multiple companies from multiple Business Central environments to access data in the same Dataverse environment. Includes company filter management, stricter document filtering, and multi-tenant Azure AD support.
caveats: Needs explicit company selection for documents to avoid conflicts

features.name: Default Business Central environment and company selection
features.description: Users can pick and change the default Business Central environment and company for opening coupled records from Dynamics 365 Sales. This setting is preserved per user and can be changed anytime.
caveats: Per-user setting that can be changed anytime

features.name: Master data consolidation approach
features.description: Recommends consolidating data in one master data company in Business Central, then using master data management capabilities to synchronize between companies before integrating with central Dataverse or Dynamics 365 Sales. This improves performance and avoids service protection limits.
caveats: Requires manual setup of master data company

features.name: Multi-currency synchronization
features.description: Ensures seamless synchronization when multiple currencies are involved. Automatically adds Business Central local currencies to Dataverse and converts monetary amounts on the fly based on exchange rates.
caveats: Requires Dataverse base currency to be set up as regular currency in Business Central with exchange rates

features.name: Additional field mappings for integration
features.description: More fields are now available for mapping in standard integration table mappings for customer, vendor, contact, salesperson, and opportunity. These additional fields are disabled by default but can be enabled by users without developer assistance.
caveats: Additional fields are disabled by default
Requires manual enablement per integration mapping

features.name: Control over event-based synchronization
features.description: Ability to turn off event-based synchronization for specific integration table mappings to reduce data errors, improve reliability, and enhance performance by reducing synchronization events.
caveats: Default settings remain unchanged to avoid disrupting existing integrations

features.name: Virtual tables visibility during assisted setup
features.description: When enabling and connecting to Dataverse using assisted setup, users can make specific virtual tables visible during the setup process, either for a single table or in bulk for multiple tables.
caveats: Additional virtual tables can be accessed later from connection setup page

features.name: Commercial licensing for Dynamics 365 app integration
features.description: Commercial blockers for integrating various Dynamics 365 apps have been removed. Attached licenses now available for Business Central premium and Enterprise versions of Sales, Customer Service, and Field Service.
caveats: Check partner portal for specific licensing details

features.name: Automatic coupling criteria recommendation
features.description: System now automatically recommends coupling criteria for simple tables such as payment terms and currencies, reducing manual setup work for users.
caveats: Only applies to simple tables with obvious coupling fields
